name: membership-card
title: Membership card
description: A digital membership card: member, tier, member since and valid until, with a QR code that opens large for scanning and a copyable member number.
docs: member is { name, number, image? } and tier is set large. since is written as month and year and validUntil as a date, in locale and timeZone (a day such as '2027-01-17' never shifts with the zone). qr is a node, so you can pass the kit's QR code, an svg, an img or your own: it must fill its box and be drawn with dark modules, because the code always sits on a white tile, in light and in dark. Tapping the tile opens the same code large in a dialog, also on white, with the name and number below it, for scanning. The member number is a mono value with a copy button that says when it is copied. status is active or expired: an expired card says 'Expired on 3 Mar 2026', mutes the tier and the picture, and hides the code, so nobody holds up something that no longer opens the door. organisation replaces the small line at the top, and it wraps to two lines before it is cut. The card answers to its own width: on a narrow card the code sits beside the tier and the member takes a full row below. The card is named by the member and the tier ('Maya Okafor, Gold membership'), and labels carries every word.
